Jones was victorious for us in the Shot Putt with 37ft. 9½in., beating Grigg, of the Police by nearly a foot, with Sutton a close third. Melchior was our third man with 32ft. 5in., and we won the event by a margin of one point.
Grigg, pulled back the lost ground by a series of good performances.

Grigg, who had a very busy evening in winning the Weight and Discus and securing third place in the Javelin. Bill Sutton was second in the Weight and also gained third place in the Discus, but Bill seems to miss the support of Syd Jones, our other " strong " man, who is in the Services.
